key_insight: The local tangent residual (LTR) estimates whether nonlinear compression can outperform POD in turbulent-flow datasets before training an autoencoder.
engineering_relevance: LTR can help practitioners avoid costly autoencoder architecture searches and hyperparameter tuning when POD is sufficient.
method: Compute LTR from local data geometry without model training or a threshold parameter.
Assess nonlinear compression using autoencoders relative to POD.
Quantify trained-decoder nonlinearity using decoder linearisation error (DLE).
evidence_signal: Across two vortex street cases and a wind-turbine turbulent wake, LTR reproduced dominant trends in autoencoder compression performance, with large nonlinear potential corroborated by large DLE.
watch_item: Validation covers three flow cases; reliability for broader turbulent-flow regimes remains to be established.
paper_title: A Priori Estimation of the Non-Linear Compression Potential and Quantification of Autoencoder Non-Linearity in Turbulent Flows
